title: Colour & Tone: Primary & Secondary
welcome_lead: Mix the rainbow from just three primary colours.
meta_desc: KS3 colour: primaries, secondaries, tertiary colours and the wheel.
final_note: Three primaries unlock every other colour on the wheel.

concepts.def: Red, yellow or blue — cannot be mixed.
Mix of two primaries: orange, green, purple.
The name of a colour, like red or blue.
Coloured powder used to make paint.

walkthroughs.body_html: Red, yellow and blue are the primary colours in paint. You cannot mix them from anything else, but you can mix them together to make every other colour.
Red + yellow = orange. Yellow + blue = green. Blue + red = purple. These are the secondary colours.
Arrange the six colours in a circle and you have a colour wheel. Tertiary colours sit between each primary and secondary — like red-orange or blue-green.
